Hon'ble Narendra Kumar Johari,J.
A short counter affidavit filed by learned AGA today is taken on record.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned AGA who appears on behalf of State-respondents and perused the record.

This writ petition has been filed with a prayer to issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Certiorari for quashing of First Information Report dated 11.7.2023 registered as Case Crime No.
291 of 2023 under Sections 376, 328, 504, 506 IPC at P.S. Aashiyana, District Lucknow and for a direction to the respondents not to arrest the petitioner pursuant to the impugned FIR.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner has pointed out our earlier order dated 3.8.2023 has some sequence order passed on 23.8.2023.
It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that no reply regarding the same has been given.

Learned AGA, on the other hand, has relied upon paragraph 3 onward of the affidavit filed by Anil Kumar Pandey, the Additional Incharge Inspector, P.S. Aashiyana, District Lucknow and has read out paragraph 6 of the same wherein the informant has made statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C.
in support of the prosecution story.
The Investigating Officer has stated that after such statement was recorded, on the spot inspection was done and the call detail records of the petitioner was retrieved.
From the call detail records that were retrieved, the complicity of the petitioner has been established.

This Court is only concerned with the FIR that was lodged by the informant against the petitioner,
whether she is a habitual blackmailer has to be seen on the basis of evidence which is to be evaluated by the trial Court.
This Court cannot go into.

The impeachment of character of the informant as it is evident from the counter affidavit that has been filed that sufficient evidence has been collected by the Investigating Officer against the petitioner and charge sheet has been prepared and submitted to the supervisory authority.
In view of the aforesaid, writ petition is dismissed.
